title: Teukolsky Master Equation for a Kerr-like metric with Mass Quadrupole Moment
summary: The Teukolsky Master Equation (TME) is a powerful technique used to study perturbations of a spacetime with gravitational, electromagnetic, and neutrino components. The well-known Kerr metric is a suitable candidate for this formalism because it is a Petrov type D metric. However, the Kerr metric represents the exterior spacetime of a perfect sphere and only black holes are described using this metric.
